MOZ.note: Research paper on Emakhuwa language resources; says nothing on AI harms.
No government use of AI stated.
No AI law or rule stated.

facts.fact: The EMNLP 2024 paper by Ali, Lopes Cardoso and Sousa-Silva presents the first manually translated Portuguese-Emakhuwa news bitext, news topic classification datasets and monolingual data for Mozambique's most widely spoken language, with models, code and datasets released under CC BY 4.0.
